clusters.name: Shopify Catalog Synchronization
clusters.reason: Groups all items related to Shopify listing visibility, Solr data parsing for Shopify variants, and status messaging for disconnected shops within the Pre-Order application.

clusters.name: Order Parking Management
clusters.reason: Consolidates features allowing users to select specific virtual queues (parking) for fetching and releasing orders based on user preferences.

clusters.name: Product Identifier Configuration
clusters.reason: Includes changes to how product identifiers (SKUs, IDs) are displayed, permissioned, and managed within the application settings.

clusters.name: Inventory Variance Logs
clusters.reason: Focuses on the capture and aggregation of physical count scan events and variance reporting in the local database.

clusters.name: Transfer Order Recordkeeping
clusters.reason: Covers updates to the metadata and timing accuracy for received transfer order records.

clusters.name: Settings Screen Layout
clusters.reason: Addresses user interface visibility issues where dropdown selections were previously obstructed by screen boundaries.

clusters.name: Application Component Permissions
clusters.reason: Manages the visibility of cross-application navigation components based on specific user security roles.
